sources.title: Models · FastFlowLM
sources.snippet: FastFlowLM curates the most requested families and publishes tuned manifests under flm pull <model>. We validate every build on Ryzen™ AI laptops and provide matching cards—see them here. The catalog already covers models spanning Qwen3.6 (MoE), Qwen3.5 (Vision), Gemma4 (omni), Qwen3, GPT-OSS-20B (MoE), DeepSeek-R1, Whisper (Audio), MedGemma (Medical), and other leading open families.

sources.title: FastFlowLM · FastFlowLM
sources.snippet: FastFlowLM (FLM) delivers an Ollama-style developer experience built exclusively for AMD Ryzen™ AI NPUs. Install in seconds, stream tokens instantly, and run context windows up to 256k — all with dramatically better efficiency than GPU-first stacks. The FastFlowLM team is now part of AMD.

sources.title: Run & Benchmark Qwen3.5 0.8B: Smallest Multimodal AI Model
sources.snippet: Quick answer. Qwen3.5 0.8B is Alibaba's smallest multimodal model, with a 262K context window and native vision support. Pull it with `ollama run qwen3.5:0.8b` for text or run the GGUF in llama.cpp for image input. Expect strong recall but weak code accuracy — bump to Qwen3.5 4B for any coding task.
